# External layer: BMW VIN structural decode (`vin`)

Deterministic, vehicle-agnostic BMW-group VIN decode layer. Encodes only standard /
structural facts: WMI prefix → brand/plant, and the meaning of each of the 17 VIN
positions. It does **not** assert vehicle-specific values (no "this VDS == this model");
those live in BMW's proprietary VDS tables and are out of scope for an openly-licensed layer.

## Outputs

| File | Schema |
|------|--------|
| `build/external/vin_wmi.ndjson` | `{ wmi, make, brand, country, plant_hint, source }` |
| `build/external/vin_position.ndjson` | `{ position, meaning, source }` |

`vin_position.ndjson` carries 17 structural rows (positions 1–17) plus 30 synthetic
`"10:<char>"` rows giving the position-10 model-year letter → year mapping.

## Upstream sources

| Source | URL | License |
|--------|-----|---------|
| NHTSA vPIC `DecodeVin` API | https://vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/api/vehicles/DecodeVin/<vin>?format=json | US Government **public domain** |
| Wikibooks: VIN codes / WMI + Model year | https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Vehicle_Identification_Numbers_(VIN_codes) | **CC BY-SA** |
| jakkuh/bmw-vin-decoder (structural cross-check only) | https://github.com/jakkuh/bmw-vin-decoder | no SPDX tag at fetch time; only ISO structure used |
| ISO 3779 / ISO 3780 | VIN structure standard | standard (structure only) |

## fetched vs reconstructed

- **fetched / validated (`source:"nhtsa-vpic"`)**: 5 WMIs confirmed live against the NHTSA
  vPIC `DecodeVin` API in this session: `WBA` (BMW, Munich/DE), `WMW` (MINI, Oxford/UK),
  `SCA` (Rolls-Royce, Goodwood/UK), `5UX` (BMW, Greer SC/USA), `3MW` (BMW, San Luis Potosi/MX).
- **reconstructed (`source:"wikibooks"`)**: 19 further BMW-group WMIs from the published
  Wikibooks WMI table / manufacturer-published usage (`WBS WBX WBY WB5 3MF 4US 5UM 5YM 5YV
  WB1 WB2 WB3 WB4 WMZ WMB SCB SLA LBV LE4`). Standard prefix→brand/plant facts only.
- **position rules (`source:"iso-3779"`)**: the 17-position layout (WMI 1–3, VDS 4–9 incl.
  check digit at 9, VIS 10–17 incl. model-year char at 10 and plant at 11) and the
  position-10 model-year table are ISO 3779/3780 standard structure, cross-checked against
  the fetched Wikibooks model-year page.

No vehicle-specific values are fabricated; only standard/structural data is encoded.

## Retrieval

- Upstream URLs above.
- Retrieved: 2026-06-24.
- Generated by: `parsers/ext_vin.mjs` (zero-dep Node ESM, streaming NDJSON).

## Join conventions

- `wmi` and model-year letters are uppercase chassis/identifier tokens.
- No hex byte fields here (VIN is alphanumeric), so the `0x`-prefix rule does not apply.
